title: Leanne V NDE 113
content:
I was in a dark space. There were others around me, to both my sides, above and below me. The dark space I was in was almost ‘soupy’, filled with liquid mercury. I was floating in that mercury. There was a lighted "doorway" above me, and the light from outside that door flooded the vast room I was in. I was struggling to make it to the doorway, but somehow I then knew I couldn't make it yet. I realized I had to stay and help the people who were crying out below

environment.environment_other_detail: A vast dark space/room described as 'soupy', filled with 'liquid mercury', in which the experiencer was floating; a lighted 'doorway' above with light flooding in from outside the door.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: She 'knew I couldn't make it yet' to the lighted doorway and 'realized I had to stay and help the people who were crying out below.'
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Felt required to stay and help others who were crying out below rather than go through the lighted doorway.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Presence of other people/souls in the dark space; attempt to reach a lighted doorway but feeling unable and needing to help those below who were crying out.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Narrative begins directly in a dark realm/environment with a lighted doorway/threshold above; no explicit OBE, tunnel, or return-to-body described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Dark space described as 'soupy', filled with 'liquid mercury', with others positioned to both sides, above and below; a lighted 'doorway' above flooding the room with light; felt compelled to stay and help people crying out below.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The dark space I was in was almost ‘soupy’, filled with liquid mercury.” “There was a lighted 'doorway' above me… I was struggling to make it to the doorway, but somehow I then knew I couldn't make it yet. I realized I had to stay and help the people who were crying out below”
